payload.title: Mitigation studies: invariance gate, twin averaging, fine-tuning (published, lives in Jev-Flywheel)
payload.description: Done 2026-09-22 in Jev-Flywheel, not in the harness: learning-loop arms with a 2 percent invariance gate, twin averaging (shortlist ratio 0.48 to 0.79), Laya fine-tune on 140 labels reduced flips against prediction. Published as https://anth.us/blog/can-you-fix-it/. The harness measures; mitigation stays there.
